title: Dragon Expansion
description: Defeat the Ender Dragon to obtain its fragments, refine it into Dragon Essence, and forge powerful Dragon Gear with unique abilities.
body:
# Dragon Expension

## What is inside of this datapack.
- This datapack adds a **armor with unique abilities.**
- Once **dragon is defeated** you get its **fragments** that can be used to get the **powerful dragon armor.**

## How to get the **dragons armor**?
- Simple, you just need to have **dragons fragments** and add it into a **cauldron with dragons breath.**
- Once **cauldron is fused** add a **dragons fragments** and then you will get **dragons essence.**
- Then you just need to do the **same thing** but instead of **dragons fragments** add **dragons essence** and then your **netherite armor.**

## What to be aware of?
- **Be aware** that the **armor** that you add **will lose its all enchantments.**
- This is just a **datapack** so that means that **the armor** will be **useless** without the **datapack.**
- **Armor** cant be **reverted** so once you turned it into a **dragons armor** then it **will be that forever.**

## Abilities
### Helmet
- Night vision
- When you damage someone, you gain strength 1
### Chestplate
- Regeneration 3 every 5 seconds.
### Leggings
- Faster Movement Speed
- Survive 4 more blocks when falling
### Boots
- Fire Resistance
- Lava Walker (You can walk on lava)

### All
- Creative Flight
- To activate/deactivate you must jump two times like normal creative flight
- When in the air, your mining is slower

## Useful Commands
### Dragon's Helmet

```
function tinys_de:give/dragons_helmet
```
or

```
loot give @s loot tinys_de:give/dragons_helmet
```
